senses.gloss:
दिब्राकर of Golagrāma, son of Bhaṭṭācārya, had five
sons: Kṛṣṇa, Viṣṇu, Mallāri (Grahalāghavaṭīkā),
Keśava and Viśvanātha (Keśavajātakapaddhatyudā-
haraṇa). Kṛṣṇa was the father of Nṛsiṃha (Sūrya-
[]
siddhāntavāsanābhāṣya), grandfather of Divākara.
Cambr. 42. Oxf. 337^b. L. 1897. 2025.
